newsitem.title: CHINA: Foreign investment grows in China's Fujian.
newsitem.headline: Foreign investment grows in China's Fujian.

text.p: China's southeastern province of Fujian has attracted almost $5.0 billion in contracted foreign investment this year, the Xinhua news agency said on Monday.

The coastal province, separated from major investor Taiwan by just a narrow strait, approved 1,276 new projects and received actual foreign investment of $2.854 billion in the first eight months of 1995, the agency said.
Although the number of new projects fell by 13.8 percent compared with the same 1995 period, the contractual value of investment hit $4.896 billion, surging by 40.8 percent, it said.
Fujian now had 19,827 overseas-funded companies, of which 11,022 had already started operation. Realised investment totalled $16.583 billion, it said but gave no further details.
